Sheike.fullPrice: Refund (instant or standard) or credit note. This includes items on a temporary promotion or bought with a discount code.
Sheike.sale: Marked-down sale items can only be returned for Sheike credit.
Sheike.other: Swimwear and bodysuits must keep the hygiene strip in place. In-store returns have a $400 limit per transaction.

Forever New.saleShort: no refund, gift card or exchange only
Forever New.fullPrice: Refund to your original payment method, or an exchange. Exchanges are in store only.
Forever New.sale: Sale items can't be returned for a refund if you change your mind. They can be exchanged for a Forever New gift card or another item.
Forever New.other: Items must be unworn with tags attached. Online orders older than 14 days can't be returned through the portal.

JAG.window: 21 days from delivery (bought 17 Nov to 24 Dec 2026: until 17 Jan 2027)
JAG.fullPrice: Refund or exchange. Post returns cost $8.99, taken from your refund; returns to JAG's own stores are free. Afterpay and PayPal orders are refund only.
JAG.sale: Final sale items (marked down to clear, including extra discounts on those) can't be returned, exchanged or refunded for change of mind. They're labelled Final Sale on the product page.
JAG.other: Must be unworn, unwashed, with tags. Not for items bought through David Jones or Myer.

Kirstin Ash.window: 30 days from purchase, but not for earrings
Kirstin Ash.fullPrice: Earrings can't be returned for hygiene reasons. Other full-price pieces: refund or credit voucher within 30 days, unworn. Full-price pieces bought during a storewide discount can still be returned.
Kirstin Ash.sale: No change-of-mind returns on sale items.
Kirstin Ash.other: Only for purchases from kirstinash.com, not stockists. Engraved pieces are final. This is the policy on Kirstin Ash's NZ site; the AU page couldn't be checked.
